title: The First Email Ever Sent Was Basically Keyboard Mashing

scenes.text: The first email ever sent was gibberish.
It was 1971, in Cambridge, Massachusetts. Engineer Ray Tomlinson wanted to test if computers could swap messages.
He sent a test between two machines sitting side by side.
scenes.keywords: two old computers side by side

scenes.text: The message was something like QWERTYUIOP. The top row of the keyboard.
He also picked the at sign to separate a name from a place.
Every email address since uses it. All thanks to a keyboard mash.

The first email ever sent was gibberish.

What was the first thing you ever emailed?
